D5/S3/Quantum/ObserverCommutator.observe.name: D5.S3.Quantum.ObserverCommutator.observer_read_update_commutator_formula
D5/S3/Quantum/ObserverCommutator.observe.signature: theorem observer_read_update_commutator_formula {index : Type*} (tau : Equiv.Perm index) (f : index -> Complex) (psi : Register index) : observerUpdate tau (readObservable f psi) - readObservable f (observerUpdate tau psi) = fun i => (f (tau.symm i) - f i) * psi (tau.symm i)
